data.investment_objective: To generate regular income through investment in a portfolio comprising predominantly of ﬂoating rate instruments and ﬁxedrate instruments swapped for ﬂoating rate returns. The Scheme may also invest a portion of its net assets in ﬁxed rate debtand money market instruments. However, there can be no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of thescheme would be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Floating Rate Debt Instruments (including Fixed Rate Debt Instruments swapped for ﬂoating rate returns) - (65%-100%), Debtand Money Market Instruments - (0%-35%), Units issued by REITs & InvITs - (0%-10%)
data.benchmark: NIFTY Medium to Long Duration Debt Index A-III
data.fund_managers: Mr. Aditya Pagaria, Mr. Hardik Shah
